# IconButton

A round action button that gives its icon a clear accessible name.

## Basic usage

<DemoPreview name="icon-button" />

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | Required | Accessible name |
| `disabled` | boolean | false | Blocks interaction |
| `pressed` | boolean | undefined | Optional toggle state |

### Slots

- default: icon, a plus sign by default

## Keyboard and usage notes

Tab to focus; Enter or Space to activate. The label must describe the action.

## Installation

```ts
import { AgmIconButton } from 'augma'
import 'augma/style.css'
```
